title: Chaos Gloves

{{armor art infobox | campaign = [[Eye of the north]] | pvpreward = Fancy | specialgallery = Chaos Gloves }} [[Chaos Gloves]] are a prestige glove art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the [[Deldrimor title track]] to be able to craft this armor. {| style="margin:0.5em; border:1px solid {{x-color|border}}; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:90%;" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0" rules="all" |- style="background:{{x-color|background}};" ! style="font-size:120%;" colspan="12" | Crafting |- style="background:{{x-color|tint}};" ! 75 {{Ecto}} |} ==Dye== * [[Dye]] affects the entirety of the gloves and the auras. * Like all items with the "chaos" glowing appearance, if two or more dyes are combined, the result will be counter-intuitive. * The default color can be closely replicated using gray dye. {{dye chart}} == Notes == [[Image:Chaos Gloves postprocessing.jpg|right|thumb|100px|Top: Without PPE
Bottom: With PPE]] * Similar to all [[Mesmer]] gloves, the Mesmer Chaos Gloves [[:Image:Screenshot mesmer f chaos gloves.jpg|only come up to the wrist]]. * If you use an [[Expert Salvage Kit]] on the gloves, they will [[salvage]] into one of the following: ** 30-40 Piles of Glittering Dust, 2-3 Globs of Ectoplasm ** 25-39 Globs of Ectoplasm ** Piles of Glittering Dust. === Coloring notes === * When dyed certain colors, there is an extension of the glow from the hand for some female characters. * Part of the ''glow'' is generated through post-processing effects, which many people turn off (either because their system performs better or to avoid changes to the screen as a result being [[drunk]]). * Black (and to a lesser extent silver) dye can dim the glow of the gloves by decreasing the distance of the colored aura from the arm (the color of the arm does not change). {{bug|When Chaos Gloves are viewed through a semi-transparent surface, such as in water or under an Ooze, they disappear, making your character appear to not have hands.}} {{bug|If a character cycles between their chaos gloves and another pair of gloves at a semi-fast rate, the chaos gloves will appear with an orange shaded-in box around them for a few milliseconds.}} {{common armor nav}} [[Category:Common armor]] [[Category:Prestige armor]] [[Category:Contains dust]] [[Category:Contains ectoplasm]]
